title: Who is in a group
items: Groups: tap the number of members to see who is in a group and who is invited
New exercise view: after typing a number of repetitions, tapping outside only closes the keyboard and saves – it no longer opens another exercise by accident
New exercise view: a finished timer only shows Reset, so the card stays small
New exercise view: the exercise page no longer shows an empty "Finished by" line

title: Try the new exercise view
items: New and optional: calmer exercise cards and a page for every exercise – turn it on in Options → General → Try the new exercise view
Big start and + / − buttons right on the card; tap the card for everything else
Add a description and steps to your exercises (exercise page → ⋯ → Description & steps)
Guided workout: leads you through the steps with timer, sets, rests and videos that play by themselves – the creator turns it on in Description & steps
Short videos or photos for every step: upload them in Description & steps, tap to play, with slow motion and large view
Personal notes on every exercise – only you can see them
Any issues with the new view? Report them with the button at the bottom of an exercise page (needs a GitHub account)
The new cards show who else already finished
With the new view a running timer keeps going when you switch between the card and the exercise page
With the new view a reminder for one exercise opens it directly
You stay logged in while you use the app – no more logout in the middle of an exercise
If your login has ended, you are sent to the login page right away
Being offline no longer sends you to the login page
Editing an exercise no longer ends its current period early: a weekly exercise you change on day 2 still resets after the week

title: Reminders, timer sounds and more options
items: Reminder settings moved from Options → General to their own tab: Options → Reminders
Everything about reminders in one place: turn them on, choose your exercises, set how early they come, send a test and open the setup guide
Quiet hours: no reminders at night (Options → Reminders) – they come once the quiet hours are over
Choose the sound at the end of a timer: Beeps, Bell, Chime, Fanfare or none (Options → Timer); your own sounds will follow later
Turn off vibration on this device (Options → General)
Invite links can be shared directly to WhatsApp, Signal & co. on phones
Each Options tab has its own address – the back button returns to the previous tab
Delete your account yourself (Options → General): exercises others also use are handed over to the person who does them most often
Search exercises by name in Browse
If reminders cannot be turned on, the message now says why instead of "Server not reachable"

title: A fresh new look
items: New design with light and dark mode (Options → Appearance)
Navigation bar – on phones at the bottom of the screen
Exercise cards show goal, time left, progress and your streak at a glance
Simpler form for new exercises with a real time picker
Statistics with your streaks, completion per person and who finished when
Groups show their members; accept or decline invitations right away
What's new is shown once after an update – like this
Install the app on your phone's home screen – it starts without the browser bar and shows a message when you are offline
Large timer view while a timer runs – the screen stays on
On phones: a round + button for new exercises and groups, dialogs use the whole screen and page titles stay visible while scrolling
Sort your exercises by dragging them (sort icon at the top) and pull the page down to refresh it
On phones the top bar shows the page title with a back arrow – log out is now in Options
Statistics: the details of a day stay on the screen and are shown on tap
Reminders: get a notification when an exercise is not done yet shortly before it resets (Options → General)
Choose which exercises you are reminded of: "Remind me" in the ⋯ menu of an exercise or in Options → General
Reminders not arriving? Options → General → Setup guide shows how to set them up in Safari and Chrome
The app loads faster (a third less to download)
A note at the top shows when you are offline; your phone vibrates briefly when you mark an exercise as done
New and edited exercises get their own page instead of a small dialog
Statistics only show people who currently take part and were active in the selected time
Forgot to tap Done? Tap the + on a missed day in the statistics (last 7 periods) – replaces the Missed Entry tab
Change your password in Options; if you forgot it, ask the admin for a reset link
Fixed: reset times now follow summer and winter time (they moved by an hour before)
Fixed: tapping "Mark as done" several times quickly no longer causes errors
Fixed: creating exercises, the back button, a timer that finished immediately and the time left below one hour

title: Missed entries
items: Add a missed entry for a period you finished but forgot to track
Fixed: groups were not shown when editing an exercise

title: Options and invite links
items: Options page with invite link generation
The user menu links to Options

title: Timers
items: Exercise cards collapse when you mark them as done
Timer exercises with a sound when the time is up
Better layout on small screens

title: Groups and statistics
items: Groups that are invite-only or public
Statistics for every exercise
Browse and add public exercises
